title: K+ 6.9 with ECG changes

beats.text: NPC: banana. Waits for the repeat.
SIGMA: IV calcium first. Protect the heart.

caption:
Hyperkalaemia with ECG changes: IV calcium first to stabilise the myocardium. It doesn't lower K+. Insulin-glucose does that next.
